summary: Modernization platform shows good architectural separation but lacks comprehensive testing, security hardening, and production readiness for banking domain requirements.

hotspots.reason: High complexity with 25 imports suggests potential tight coupling and single responsibility violations
JSON file-based storage lacks ACID properties and concurrent access controls required for banking operations
Context storage mechanism lacks encryption and access controls for sensitive banking data

provenance.evidence: No evidence of encryption or access controls

risks.title: Banking Compliance Gap
risks.description: Platform lacks SOX, PCI-DSS, and banking regulation compliance controls required for financial data processing

risks.title: Data Migration Integrity
risks.description: No evidence of transactional data migration strategy from Access to PostgreSQL with rollback capabilities

risks.title: Legacy System Integration
risks.description: Missing integration patterns and fallback mechanisms for gradual strangler fig migration

risks.title: Production Scalability
risks.description: File-based configuration and storage patterns will not scale for banking transaction volumes
